pick.name: Kopia
pick.what: Encrypted, deduplicated, versioned backup with a GUI and CLI
pick.why: Best free backup tool with GUI: encrypted, incremental, any backend (S3/R2/B2/SFTP/rclone)
pick.free_limits: Free; storage cost is your backend's

alts.name: Syncthing
alts.what: Peer-to-peer folder sync with no cloud

candidates.name: Google Drive / iCloud / OneDrive / Dropbox
candidates.verdict: Cloud sync; pair with a backup, sync is not backup

candidates.name: Backblaze / Arq
candidates.verdict: Paid turnkey backup; not verified this pass

decision: Pair one cloud drive for everyday sync (iCloud, Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox, whichever fits your ecosystem) with Kopia for versioned, encrypted backups to cheap object storage. Sync services mirror deletions and ransomware; only a backup protects you. Choose a paid turnkey service such as Backblaze or Arq if you want no setup.
details: Cloud drive choice intentionally not ranked and not researched this pass.

verify.note: Apache-2.0, ~14.5k stars, v0.23.1 (2026-06-16), commits 2026-10-28. Defensible; a turnkey paid service (Backblaze/Arq) could flip it for non-technical founders, as the decision already says.
